services.name: Two Hour Fishing Experience
services.desc: Two Hour Charter: $375 Price Includes up to 6 People! Start Time Our charters begin +/- 1 Hour of your selected start time. The Captain will be in touch, IF there are any changes to your departure Time. About Trip will consist of 1 hour of travel time and 1 hour of Fishing. We commonly see Dolphin throughout the experience and the Captain will be targeting the absolute easiest and most active Target of the Season. This trip is Perfect for the Hot Summer Afternoons. What to Bring We provide all of the equipment needed for the trip. Guests are encouraged to bring sunscreen and sunglasses, $375 · For Up to 6 People · Perfect for the Hot Summer Afternoons!

services.name: Three Hour Shark Charter

For larger parties, please give us a call and we will do our best to make something work! All gear, For up to 6 People · Great for Families with Young Children! (May thru Oct Only)
